correctness.rationale: The antiperiodic Green sequence satisfies 4g0-2g1=1 and 4gj-g(j-1)-g(j+1)=0; source decomposition recovers rim and chord columns. Absolute-value orbit pairing gives exact formulas, and elementary estimates prove strict rim maximality. The active threshold L_n=(log n)/log(2+sqrt3)+O(1), with a geometrically controlled tail, yields the sharp coefficient 2/log(2+sqrt3). Direct independent grounded-Laplacian rational reconstruction checked 264 edge columns (n=3..13), and does not substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The endpoint projection norm is a natural Banach-space invariant. The theorem isolates a logarithmic order-(log n)/n finite-size effect even though the nonconstant Green component decays geometrically, determines its exact coefficient, and resolves the competing rim/chord edge classes over an infinite parameter family. These are nontrivial structural effects rather than arbitrary finite tables.
